last_result.headline: Conditional per-well uncertainty carries no usable information (CV R^2 0.074; Mondrian intervals WIDER than marginal at matched coverage) -> per-well confidence gating closed on test-available features. Marginal conformal bound retained (90% <=13.43ft). Most valuable output: for a FIXED model a random 3-well draw pools to 5th 3.491 / median 6.708 / 95th 15.138, and OOF 4.756 on the 3 test wells vs public 7.891 = 1.659x transfer gap.
